intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
IIM Lucknow vs Jaipuria Lucknow is not a single winner. IIM Lucknow holds NIRF 2025 #5 on our records, and Jaipuria Lucknow holds NIRF 2025 #67.

sections.heading: IIM Lucknow vs Jaipuria Lucknow for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIM Lucknow if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #5, and a 2025 flagship package record of ₹32.3 LPA, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Lucknow.
Choose Jaipuria Lucknow if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #67, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹9 LPA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Lucknow.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹20.75 lakh as a programme total for Post Graduate Programme (PGP) at IIM Lucknow.
Jaipuria's official PGDM 2027-29 fee PDF lists a Lucknow campus grand total of ₹13.50 lakh, with hostel charged separately.
Our recorded figure for Jaipuria Lucknow is ₹7.38 lakh on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Retail Management. Check it against the official notice before you decide.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IIM Lucknow's latest recorded flagship year here is 2025, with an average of ₹32.3 LPA and a highest package of ₹75 LPA on Post Graduate Program in Agribusiness Management (PGP-ABM). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Jaipuria Lucknow's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹9 LPA and a highest package of ₹22 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Financial Services. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2025 and 2023, so the packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: IIM Lucknow is listed on our records with CAT, GMAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Jaipuria Lucknow is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Uttar Pradesh. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
IIM Lucknow is listed as a public institute and Jaipuria Lucknow as a private institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If ranks and the wider recruiter mix matter most, IIM Lucknow is the stronger recorded option on this page, with NIRF 2025 #5 against NIRF 2025 #67.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Jaipuria Lucknow's recorded ₹7.38 lakh or IIM Lucknow's ₹20.75 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, IIM Lucknow or Jaipuria Lucknow?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. IIM Lucknow and Jaipuria Lucknow differ in more than one way: IIM Lucknow holds NIRF 2025 #5 on our records, while Jaipuria Lucknow holds NIRF 2025 #67, and one is listed as public and the other as private.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for IIM Lucknow vs Jaipuria Lucknow?
faqs.answer: see official sources for IIM Lucknow; Jaipuria's official PGDM 2027-29 fee PDF lists a Lucknow campus grand total of ₹13.50 lakh, with hostel charged separately. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for IIM Lucknow and Jaipuria Lucknow?
faqs.answer: IIM Lucknow's latest recorded flagship year here is 2025, with an average of ₹32.3 LPA and a highest package of ₹75 LPA on Post Graduate Program in Agribusiness Management (PGP-ABM). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do IIM Lucknow and Jaipuria Lucknow accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT, GMAT for IIM Lucknow, and CAT for Jaipuria Lucknow. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are IIM Lucknow and Jaipuria Lucknow in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
